notes: Assertions mirror score.py. `target` decides whether run.py appends the no-integrations note: in-conversation cases get no suffix, external cases do. trigger_cases.json is a separate suite — it measures whether the skill fires at all.

evals.prompt: I just investigated a payment webhook failure. Here's what I found: the service logs show a NullPointerException at PaymentService.ts:142 when webhook.metadata is null, which happens for all v2 API partners. Error rate is about 12 per hour since the deploy at 2pm (deploy ID: abc123). Only partners with the apiVersion: "v2" flag are affected — we have 8 such partners. Can you summarize what I found and what I should do about it?
evals.expected_output: In-conversation summary: bullet findings with inline code refs, numbered next steps, TL;DR last. No attribution tag, no title field, no filler.
assertions: within_line_budget — no line over 20 words
no_filler_phrases — no 'here's a summary', 'hope this helps' etc.
tldr_present — a TL;DR line exists (3+ findings)
tldr_is_last_section — TL;DR comes after the last bullet and numbered step
findings_as_bullets — at least 3 bullet findings, not prose
inline_code_ref — PaymentService.ts:142 appears inline
numbered_next_steps — at least 2 numbered next steps
no_preamble — first line is not 'Here's...' or 'Based on...'
no_attribution_tag — in-conversation output carries no [Text Generated by AI] tag
no_title_field — no 'Title:' field; this is not an issue draft

assertions: within_line_budget — no line over 20 words
no_filler_phrases — no 'here's a summary', 'hope this helps' etc.
title_has_category_prefix — title starts with [Bug]/[Feature]/[Chore]/[Spike]
title_max_10_words — title is 10 words or fewer
attribution_tag_present — [Text Generated by AI - <model_id>] appears
tag_before_body_content — the tag precedes the first body bullet
title_has_no_tag — the tag is not in the title field
action_items_as_checklist — at least 2 '- [ ]' items
detail_bullets_present — at least 3 detail bullets
content_only_no_wrapper — draft is postable as-is, no 'here's what I'd post' wrapper
